We need DBE for C12H7O3Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens as H). For halogens, treat as H. So effective H = H + X (Cl). So H_eff = 7 + 1 = 8. No N. So DBE = C - H_eff/2 +1 = 12 - 8/2 +1 = 12 -4 +1 =9. So integer 9.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
